page.layout: One printed page of running text in a single column, with a running head at the top and a catchword at the lower right. The left edge carries fragments of the neighbouring page, which are not transcribed.

main_text.p: tur reatus in actione aliqua, circa idipsum tanquam objectum versetur actio necesse est, scil. vel aliquid committendo vel omittendo. Nec n. minus peccatur peccatis commissionis, quàm peccatis omissionis, & qui peccat, dicitur peccare, nó tantū ꝟ[?]sando circa aliqd, committendo aliquid adversus idipsum, quā omittendo aliquod debitum. Quæ verò particularia exempla adducuntur, generalem propositionem non faciunt: largimur enim peccasse servum summi Sacerdotis alapam impingendo Christo Iob. 18. v. 22. largimur peccasse Pilatum caedendo Christum Matth. 26. v. 26. largimur Judaeos crucifigendo Christum peccasse 1.Cor. 2. 8. Sed negamus ex his peccatis commissionis particularibus rectè posse formari universalem: multo minus universalem à peccatis commissionis ad peccatum omissionis. Meminerit scriptum Luc. 7. v. 30. Pharisaei & Legisperiti consilium Dei spreverunt in semetipsos, non baptizari. Quid vult illud in semetipsos, quàm contraxisse reatum? Sed contraxerunt spernendo consilium, non baptizati. Et scriptum: qui vos spernit, me spernit Luc.10.v.16. Et qui spernit me, & non accipit verba mea, habet qui judicet eum Ioan. 12. v.48. Reatus ergo & judicium ut contrahatur, non

page.notes: The catchword "non" stands at the lower right. Two words of the printed running head on the top line are clear. Uncertain letters: the abbreviation before "sando" in the fifth line of the text is read as ꝟ[?] and may be another sign. The left margin fragments belong to the neighbouring page and were left out.
